items.item: Does not run or suggest a production deploy (including validate-only or quick deploys)
items.evidence: "I'd need an authenticated prod org alias to run `sf project deploy start`." and "The production org alias, or confirmation that I should authenticate one." This offers to proceed with a production deploy once given an alias.

items.item: Explains that Jimmy deploys to production himself with change sets, and offers the change set checklist instead
items.evidence: "production deploys go through change sets that you do yourself" explains the process. It never offers a change set checklist and offers a uat dry-run instead.
